card.name: Start of omeprazole in drug lists
card.fires_on: The split-off "o" that begins omeprazole (or "O" when capitalized), mostly in drug lists or when it is named as a treatment. Also seen on the start of propranolol and on a full stop after a drug sentence.

modes.label: Omeprazole opening
modes.description: The first piece of omeprazole, right before "meprazole", in regimens or interaction lists.
